quest.title: Tending to a Tepetlisaurus
quest.description: While visiting the Children of Echoes, you meet a very, very busy man...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora! Be a good boy now, and stay still! I'm just going to give you a quick wipe-down...

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: *whimper* Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Come on, little one! Why don't we go take a bath?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Look, there's a pool just over there. Once we've got you cleaned up, we can come right back and keep playing!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hey, wait! No, don't run off!

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Have you come to visit our tribe? I'm so sorry about Hora. He's been a bit too energetic lately, dashing all over the place. He didn't frighten you, did he?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Were you trying to coax him into taking a bath just now?

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Coax him? *sigh* More like "beg" him. It's been raining a lot the past few days, so he's been getting covered in mud whenever he goes out to play...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: I'm trying to get him cleaned up, but all he wants to do is to run around all day and play!

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: But as an ordinary person, I just can't keep up with him...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you tried luring him over with some food?

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Yes, I've tried that already. But it's as if he knows exactly what I'm trying to do. He'll feign disinterest so long as he sees me standing nearby.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Then if I so much as glance away, he'll burrow his way over, eat it all in one go, then drill back down, making good his escape...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's almost as if he's a Tepetlisaurus...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Exactly! I can't even imagine what kind of trouble he'll cause when he's full-grown...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: I just hope he doesn't end up wrecking Cheven's store... There's no way I'll be able to reimburse her if he smashes up those gemstones.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: *sigh* I guess I'll just have to give Batz's idea from back then a try. But will a Tepetlisaurus really be interested in this ball...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who's Batz?

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Oh, he's the one in the tribe who's in charge of looking after Tepetlisaurs. He's a smart fellow, and a bit of an expert when it comes to music too. Everyone likes him, human and Saurian alike.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: When I talked to him about it way back when, he whipped out a blueprint for making something called a "Driftyball" on the spot.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: He got this thing from Mataoho, and the little Saurians seem to love it. He suggested I try making one for Hora.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Just when I'd finished gathering up the materials and was all ready to get started, Hora starts playing up again. If he was wearing pants, I'd say they were full of ants!

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Looks like this Driftyball idea is all I've got...

choices.text: Is there anything I can help with?

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: You'd be willing to help me out? That's amazing! Good thing I bumped into someone as nice as you.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Could you go to the box over there and grab some Embercore Stems for me? I'll stay here and get started on the Driftyball's frame.

choices.text: Let me know if you need a hand.
Whoa! Almost knocked me right off my feet!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You rummage through the box and find yourself a bundle of Embercore Stems...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: That's the one, thanks! I'll just... Ouch!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Apologies, I... I accidentally cut my finger while I was tying the frame just now.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: I knew I'd have trouble with fiddly work like this...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Just give me a moment to tie the stems of these flowers onto the frame, then cover it with a layer of cloth...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Cazcal continues struggling away with the Driftyball, finally managing to complete it after cutting his hand three more times...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Finished! Let's go find Hora. I bet he's digging away underneath that tree again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'd better bandage up your hand first.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about that, 'tis but a scratch. I'll find a rag to wrap it up with later.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Let's go find Hora first before he gets too carried away.

talks.objective: Put the Driftyball in the center of the pool

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You put the Driftyball in the pool.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Hroo!? Rrroo, rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With a joyful look, Hora grabs the Driftyball before rolling around in the pool. The water splashes everywhere, washing all the mud on his body off...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hahaha, seems the little rascal likes the ball. Who'd have thought he'd start playing with it in the pool right away...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Let's head over now. I guess that counts as a good wash.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Roar...? Roar!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Like that, huh, kiddo? It's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Orrooo, orrooo!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Getting you to take a bath sure wasn't easy... Haha, but at least now I know how to deal with you.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Hroo... Grooo...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Why are you touching my hand...? Oh, these are just a few little scratches, don't worry about it.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: *whimper*... Wroo, rrooh...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Why so glum all of a sudden, kiddo? You were having a great time just now! Surely you haven't worn yourself out with all this playing?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Oh, and many thanks for your help, friend. These are for you, as a reward. There's nothing particularly valuable inside, so please, just take them.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Roar! Roarrr! Roar—

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: No, Hora, wait! Not back to the pool, I just dried you off!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Uh... So we tie this bit here, then that bit there... Ehh? Is that how you're meant to do this...?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo! Rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: He's just over there — right by a pool, as it happens. If we can lure him in, we can give him a good washdown too...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: He'll notice me if I go over there, so you'll have to go alone. Just make sure you put the Driftyball in the center of the pool. I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Please, help me put the Driftyball in the center of the pool. *sigh* I can only hope Hora likes it...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hroo? Rrroooh...?
